responsibility: This file is the CHECKING_P selftest suite for GCC’s hash_map container. It validates map behavior for pointer, string-content, and integer-keyed maps, exercises insertion/lookup/removal, duplicate-key replacement semantics, maps whose values have constructors and destructors, growth and rehash behavior inherited from hash_table, and handling of nonzero empty-key sentinels, thereby testing the hash_map layer rather than the underlying generic template implementation itself.
